1.g3 d5 2.Bg2 e5 3.c4 dxc4 4.b3.strategy: Offers a second pawn to open lines: if Black takes on b3, recapturing with the queen attacks b7 twice, and recapturing with the a-pawn opens the a-file. White stays a pawn down for the activity, and Black can cover b7 again and develop calmly.
1.g3 d5 2.Bg2 e5 3.c4 dxc4 4.b3.name: Hungarian Opening: Winterberg Gambit
